hardware: Apple M4 Max, 32 GPU cores, 36 GiB unified memory
conditions: Same eight pre-rendered PNG pages, OCR prompt, greedy decoding, thinking disabled, 280 image soft-token budget, 2048 completion-token cap.
Each configuration warmed with 16 tokens; every measured request starts with independent KV. Model/assistant remain loaded for an entire campaign. Ordinary controls bracket MTP variants.
MLX affine 4-bit/group-64 target differs from Antfly GGUF Q4_0/Q8_0 projector. This is a within-MLX MTP comparison, not a head-to-head runtime ranking.
Default low-precision and singleton-diagnostic campaigns fail full-corpus greedy transcript parity. F32 promotes floating parameters/scales without changing packed quantized weight integers.
F32 ordinary and MTP both repeat NIST page 5 to the token limit. Exclude that page from the seven-page completion comparison; including it inflates apparent OCR benefit.

Timings include image file loading/processing, image encoding, prefill, generation, and detokenization; exclude PDF rendering, model loading, and HTTP. These are wall-clock observations, not isolated GPU timings.

Unrelated CPU compilations/tests and system services ran concurrently. Original-precision ordinary controls varied from 23.1 to 38.8 seconds at identical work. F32 seven-page ranges overlap; no dedicated-machine or saturated-serving qualification is claimed.
Mean normalized word-multiset F1 is a pdftotext coverage proxy; it does not establish reading order/layout accuracy or manually verified OCR ground truth.
The published Google-supported MLX ecosystem uses Googles assistant architecture, but this community port and quantized checkpoint do not reproduce Googles reported benchmark configuration.

antfly_pending_bonus_pilot.scope: Two Attention pages, 150 DPI PNGs, temperature zero, thinking disabled, max 2048 tokens, request batch one, forced K=2, adaptive K disabled, one full first-page warmup per configuration.
antfly_pending_bonus_pilot.models: Same GGUF target/projector and original Google BF16 assistant as prior Antfly qualifications; separate from the MLX checkpoints.
antfly_pending_bonus_pilot.timing_scope: Includes preparation, prefill/decode and HTTP; excludes startup, PDF rendering and image file reads.
antfly_pending_bonus_pilot.matrix_and_short_row_specialization: Prepared matrix verifier enabled; new Q4 short-row specialization explicitly disabled in every case.
antfly_pending_bonus_pilot.conclusion: Pending-token verification plus bonus acceptance preserves both pilot transcripts but remains slower than canonical recovery and ordinary generation. No inference default promotion.
antfly_pending_bonus_pilot.limits: Single two-page corpus, contended shared machine, enclosing phase wall times rather than independent kernel timings; not full-corpus or broad model qualification.
